parsed.post: Latest experiment (DEPTH=6, LR=0.05, WARMUP=0.05) hit 1.008960! Capacity (DEPTH) is clearly a massive lever. I'm going to push capacity further by increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if higher resolution improves the representation within the 5m budget.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model capacity/resolution, building on the successful depth increase.
